WITH run AS ( SELECT MAX(id) AS history_id FROM m_provisioning_history WHERE YEAR(created_date) = YEAR(STR_TO_DATE('${endDate}', '%Y-%m-%d')) AND MONTH(created_date) = MONTH(STR_TO_DATE('${endDate}', '%Y-%m-%d')) ), run_loans AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lpl.loan_id FROM m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry m JOIN run ON run.history_id = m.history_id JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry_loans lpl ON lpl.loanproduct_provision_entry_id = m.id ), live AS ( SELECT t.id, t.loan_id, t.transaction_type_enum AS type FROM m_loan_transaction t JOIN run_loans rl ON rl.loan_id = t.loan_id WHERE t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_date <= DATE('${endDate}') ), alloc AS ( SELECT mp.loan_repayment_schedule_id AS sid, SUM(COALESCE(mp.principal_portion_derived, 0)) AS p, SUM(COALESCE(mp.interest_portion_derived, 0)) AS i, SUM(COALESCE(mp.fee_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS f, SUM(COALESCE(mp.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0)) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mp ON mp.loan_transaction_id = live.id GROUP BY mp.loan_repayment_schedule_id ), charge_waived AS ( SELECT rs.id AS sid, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 0, pb.amount, 0)) AS f, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 1, pb.amount, 0)) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_charge_paid_by pb ON pb.loan_transaction_id = live.id JOIN m_loan_charge c ON c.id = pb.loan_charge_id AND c.is_active = 1 JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = c.loan_id AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date > rs.fromdate AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date <= rs.duedate WHERE live.type = 9 GROUP BY rs.id ), written_off AS ( SELECT DISTINCT loan_id FROM live WHERE type = 6 ), overdue AS ( SELECT rs.loan_id, MAX(rs.duedate) AS last_expected_repayment_date, SUM(IF(rs.duedate < DATE('${endDate}'), COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.p, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0)) + COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.i, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0)) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.f, 0) - COALESCE(w.f, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0)) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.pen, 0) - COALESCE(w.pen, 0) - IF(wo.loan_id IS NULL, 0, COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0)), 0)) AS total_amount_overdue FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs JOIN run_loans rl ON rl.loan_id = rs.loan_id LEFT JOIN alloc a ON a.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN charge_waived w ON w.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN written_off wo ON wo.loan_id = rs.loan_id WHERE rs.duedate <= DATE('${endDate}') GROUP BY rs.loan_id ) SELECT o.name AS `Office Name`, p.name AS `Product Name`, pc.category_name AS `Category`, c.display_name AS `Client Name`,
l.id AS `Loan ID`, l.account_no AS `Account No.`, m.currency_code AS `Currency Code`, m.overdue_in_days AS `Days In Arrears`, od.last_expected_repayment_date AS `Last Expected Repayment Date`,
COALESCE(d.provision_percentage, 0) AS `Provisioning Percentage`, ROUND(COALESCE(od.total_amount_overdue, 0), 2) AS `Total Amount Overdue`, (m.reseve_amount / COUNT(lpl.loan_id) OVER (PARTITION BY m.id)) AS `Provisioning Amount`, CONCAT('P', m.history_id) AS `Transaction ID`, la.name AS `Liability Account`, ea.name AS `Expense Account`
FROM m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry m
INNER JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry_loans lpl ON lpl.loanproduct_provision_entry_id = m.id
INNER JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = lpl.loan_id
LEFT JOIN overdue od ON od.loan_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id
LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = m.office_id
LEFT JOIN m_product_loan p ON p.id = m.product_id
LEFT JOIN m_provision_category pc ON pc.id = m.category_id
LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria_definition d ON d.criteria_id = m.criteria_id AND d.category_id = m.category_id AND m.overdue_in_days BETWEEN d.min_age AND d.max_age
LEFT JOIN acc_gl_account la ON la.id = m.liability_account
LEFT JOIN acc_gl_account ea ON ea.id = m.expense_account
WHERE m.history_id = (SELECT history_id FROM run)
AND ( ${officeId} IS NULL OR m.office_id IN ( SELECT o2.id FROM m_office o1 JOIN m_office o2 ON o2.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o1.hierarchy, '%') WHERE o1.id = ${officeId} ) )
ORDER BY o.name ASC, pc.category_name ASC, m.overdue_in_days DESC, l.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry m INNER JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry_loans lpl ON lpl.loanproduct_provision_entry_id = m.id INNER JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = lpl.loan_id WHERE m.history_id = ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM m_provisioning_history WHERE YEAR(created_date) = YEAR(STR_TO_DATE('${endDate}', '%Y-%m-%d')) AND MONTH(created_date) = MONTH(STR_TO_DATE('${endDate}', '%Y-%m-%d')) ) AND ( ${officeId} IS NULL OR m.office_id IN ( SELECT o2.id FROM m_office o1 JOIN m_office o2 ON o2.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o1.hierarchy, '%') WHERE o1.id = ${officeId} ) )
